product_one_liner.value: Sprinto automates security compliance, audit readiness, and risk management for companies ranging from startups to enterprises.

pricing_page.notes: Public Foundation, Growth, and Enterprise plans; pricing is quote-based.

eng_blog.notes: The public index contains GRC education, marketing, and product updates, not a qualifying engineer-authored engineering blog.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live AI Implementation Intern posting covering model-training/evaluation pipelines and LLM integration; observed November 10, 2026, not an archived November 9 snapshot.

model_provider.notes: An October 24, 2026 reproduction of Sprinto’s subprocessor disclosure explicitly lists “OpenAI AI subprocessor.” The directly readable trust-page text omits the vendor name; no specific model version is established.

compliance_certs.notes: These are Sprinto’s own Trust Center compliance claims, not merely frameworks its product supports.

raised_18mo.notes: Latest publicly reported round is April 2024, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Founding Sales Development Representative posting; observed November 10, 2026, not an archived November 9 snapshot.

launched_6mo.notes: July–August 2026 product updates announce Sprinto MCP availability on ChatGPT and Claude and a rebuilt AI security-questionnaire engine; the page is marked updated October 29, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: VP, Solutions and Customer Experience Karthik Vemparala announced his departure on June 3, 2026; his profile records his Sprinto tenure ending in June 2026.
